title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode1 Exciting News

meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll throw in that effect here at the end and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, all done!
How awesome is this lace transition?!
Not only is it really cute, it goes great with Mafuyu's lyrics too...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll have the others take a look at it now♪
<The music video's all done! I think it turned out really well, so tell me your thoughts!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I can't start working on our next song until Ena's finished with her sketch. I guess I just have to wait and see what everyone says...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, now's my chance to do some research!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Aha, here's the stuff on lucky bags from the New Year's sales! I gotta start choosing which to get since New Year's is just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, this company's also selling some...?!
And you can get 30,000 yen's worth of items for just 10,000?! Talk about a bargain!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Where are they selling these...? Oh, the shop at the mall's gonna have some.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I can order it online...
But I wanna get one in person and be a part of the festivities♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, I just peeled an orange. Would you like a couple slices?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Yeah, I'd love some!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Your sister just called.
She said she'll be coming home for New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, her plane's supposed to depart from France on New Year's Eve. She's scheduled to arrive in the evening our time on New Year's Day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll leave the orange slices on the table in the living room. Please have some whenever.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go in a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We've been calling and sending emails to each other, but it's been so long since we spoke in person... I think I was still in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's so much I wanna tell her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's been so long, it'd be great if we could go someplace together. But where...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! The New Year's sales...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really wanna go shopping with her, and I bet she's gonna want to see what the fashion scene in Japan's like right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We stopped going as much once I entered junior high, but... We used to go clothes shopping together all the time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I remember wearing some of the clothes that she made herself too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Okay, one complete outfit made to order!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
These shoes and this ribbon are so adorable, and they even go perfectly with the blouse you made for me...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, is it really okay for me to dress this cute?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Of course it is!
This outfit looks amazing on you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, we should go look at some of those accessories too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We had so much fun back then...
And I always loved it when she designed new outfits for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really want to return the favor by picking out some cute clothes for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll send an email right now to invite her to the big sales...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, because my big sis is coming home for New Year's, I probably won't be able to get much work done.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's okay. You should spend as much time with her as you can since it's been so long.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Your big sister works as a fashion designer overseas, right, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right! On top of being an amazing designer, she's got an awesome talent for putting outfits together!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I plan on checking out the New Year's sales and looking for some cute clothes with her when she gets back♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, the New Year's sales...
I saw that some places are already taking orders for lucky bags. I should check to see what's up on offer.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, you can order lucky bags online...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Convenient, right? Everywhere is super packed during New Year's, so I'd rather not go outside.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Doesn't that mean you're gonna spend most of your holidays sleeping? I know you wanna have a relaxing New Year's, but guess what's gonna happen if all you do is eat and sleep?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut up. Between my art class assignments and going around to greet my relatives, I'm going to be pretty busy this year.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Nothing's wrong, but... I always spent New Year's with my parents and went around to greet my relatives...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that's a tough one...
Normally, New Year's involves spending time with your family...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, why not go out somewhere to get a breath of fresh air? After all, staying cooped up inside isn't exactly good for your health...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <For our health... Yes, it's been hard to get myself to go outside since it's been so cold, but a walk might not be a bad idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, didn't you almost slip and fall the other day...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! When did this happen?!
Try not to get hurt or anything, okay?! That'd be an awful way to start off the new year.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Let's all do our best to have a safe and healthy New Year's!>
